question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a black ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a purple ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) black ball
(B) brown ball
(C) gold ball
(D) grey ball
(E) purple ball
(F) green ball
(G) silver ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in player order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (black, brown, gold, grey, purple, green, silver)
1. Gertrude and Dave swap: (black, brown, gold, silver, purple, green, grey)
2. Gertrude and Alice swap: (grey, brown, gold, silver, purple, green, black)
3. Gertrude and Dave swap: (grey, brown, gold, black, purple, green, silver)
4. Gertrude and Alice swap: (silver, brown, gold, black, purple, green, grey)
5. Gertrude and Eve swap: (silver, brown, gold, black, grey, green, purple)
6. Gertrude and Fred swap: (silver, brown, gold, black, grey, purple, green)
7. Gertrude and Alice swap: (green, brown, gold, black, grey, purple, silver)
Claire has the gold ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
